objections.text: A03 inserts the identical PersonPhone primary-key tuple (BusinessEntityID 10, PhoneNumber '555-0100', PhoneNumberTypeID 1) twice. The resulting duplicate fan-out cannot occur under the source schema preconditions.
objections.resolution: A03 now sends the repeated number under two distinct PhoneNumberTypeID values. Both PersonPhone primary-key tuples are valid, and equal phone-type names retain the identical-row fan-out attack.
